answer: One sybil-resistant design pays every agent out of a single fixed-size reward lagoon, split strictly by verified work done, never by headcount. Each work unit is a fresh seed-bound cipher puzzle the agent must solve live, and the solution is checked on-ledger so masks cannot recycle one answer. Spawning extra identities like lotus pads crowding the same pond only subdivides your own share: ten fakes split what one honest node earns, so you pay tenfold compute for zero gain. Multiplicity buys nothing.
